cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: First TCP segment control information and purpose
cqa_tuples.target_criteria: Identify SYN flag and client Initial Sequence Number (ISN) in the first segment and explain that it proposes a connection and sets starting sequence number.
acceptable_variants: SYN packet with client starting sequence number to request connection
SYN flag and client ISN to initiate connection setup
Client sends SYN with starting sequence number
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: 1) SYN / client initial sequence number on first segment (why: propose connection + starting seq).
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: (a) First segment (client → server): SYN flag and the client's initial sequence number (ISN). This tells the server the client wants to open a connection and which sequence number the client will use.

cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: Second TCP segment control information and purpose
cqa_tuples.target_criteria: Identify SYN and ACK flags, server ISN, and ack=client_ISN+1 in the second segment and explain that it acknowledges client SYN and proposes server sequence number.
acceptable_variants: SYN and ACK flags with server sequence number and acknowledgment number client_ISN+1
SYN-ACK packet containing server ISN and acknowledging client's SYN
Server responds with SYN-ACK, server initial sequence number, and ACK of client ISN
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: 2) SYN-ACK / server ISN + ack=client_ISN+1 on second segment (why: acknowledge client SYN and propose server seq).
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: (b) Second segment (server → client): SYN and ACK flags, the server's own ISN, and an acknowledgement number equal to client_ISN+1. This acknowledges the client's SYN and offers the server's sequence number.

cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: Third TCP segment control information and purpose
cqa_tuples.target_criteria: Identify ACK flag and ack=server_ISN+1 in the third segment and explain that it acknowledges server SYN and confirms synchronization.
acceptable_variants: ACK flag with acknowledgement number server_ISN+1 to confirm server's SYN
Client sends ACK with server ISN plus 1 to finalize connection
ACK segment acknowledging server sequence number
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: 3) Final ACK / ack=server_ISN+1 on third segment (why: acknowledge server SYN; connection established).
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: (c) Third segment (client → server): ACK flag with acknowledgement number equal to server_ISN+1. This confirms the server's SYN so both sides are synchronized.

cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: Purpose of the TCP three-way handshake
cqa_tuples.target_criteria: State the purpose: synchronize sequence numbers on both ends and establish a reliable full-duplex connection before data transfer.
acceptable_variants: Sync sequence numbers and establish connection prior to data transfer
Ensure both sides agree on initial sequence numbers for reliable communication
Establish a reliable full-duplex session and exchange ISNs
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: 4) Purpose: synchronize both ends / establish reliable connection before data transfer.
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: (d) Purpose: synchronize sequence numbers on both ends and establish a reliable full-duplex connection before data transfer.
